comments.comment: I wish there was pro-life rallies and outreaches near me, there is nothing for hours!
I freaking love this post Jenna!!
Absolutely. Really annoying when I see politicians making talk and no walk.
How many unwanted children have you adopted?
Can I get a donation to get healthcare so I can have the baby and maybe some assistance after?

Imagine how many babies and women you’d actually help if you were as loud and passionate about fighting for better health care, lower childcare costs, longer maternity leave, funding education, etc etc etc. Why not fight for a better world to raise children in rather than inserting yourself into the extremely nuanced and emotional decisions between a patient and their doctor in women’s reproductive care? You are actively hurting and making life more difficult for real, living women under the guise of saving the (often hypothetical and conveniently vague) “unborn.”
This right here. The antidote to apathy is action!
